docperms_about: Rights the sync user's role needs that no ignore_permissions can stand in for. Stock Reconciliation: ERPNext's own stock code checks the Write permission while the document is validated (get_stock_balance_for), so manna_sap_stock cannot write as a user without it (10 Nov 2026). The doctype's permissions are already Custom DocPerm rows on the site (Stock Manager), so adding a row does not switch any standard row off. Every right is spelled out: a row posted with only some rights gets write/create/delete = 1 by default. Item: the same stock code (_get_stock_balance) also checks Read on Item; read-only, nothing else. The endpoints themselves write items with ignore_permissions after their own role check.
